3. REQ-BDC-0720, 0724, 0725, 0730: replace TargetResolver/spawn_worker_with/run_due_with
   usage with upstream target APIs. Preserve built-in/Python switching, rollback,
   trust checks, mode lock, run identity, outages and bounded graceful/hurried stop.
replacement: Name the outage cases the migration must preserve: failed spawn, timeout, and transport failure each leave cached reads available and record an outage for the affected scope.

sentence:
ADR-STORE-0001: keep every v3 table and index unchanged; schema extensions may
add only nullable columns or new tables. No migration may rewrite the v3 contract.
replacement: State that the upstream ScheduleStore migration changes the store implementation while retaining the v3 tables and indexes, and that any schema extension is limited to nullable columns or new tables.

sentence:
ANC-004: the optional consumer-registered post-sync hook receives every sync result
and error.
replacement: Specify that the preserved hook receives both each sync result and its associated error, including after switching to upstream target APIs.

sentence: Keep clap and server/runtime assembly out of independently resolved API/Python consumer builds.
replacement: Clarify that the dependency-boundary check must reject direct Dolt-table access and permit beads-backend access only through bd in the independently resolved API and Python consumer builds.

sentence: schedule built-in sync, read locally, journal a supported write, drain/read-back, observe outage/recovery, switch to Python sync, observe post-sync results/errors, and stop/restart the daemon.
replacement: Specify that a consumer-registered Python sync method replaces the hard-coded bd sync.

sentence: The daemon hosts the cache-file schedules, not a second scheduler database.
replacement: State that each repository may have at most one built-in bd sync schedule row in sc-cron, and that attempts to add another are rejected.
exclude --id ANC-009 --item c-2 --reason "This sprint uses the existing sync scopes but does not define or change their bd-filter configuration."

sentence:
NFR-BDC-0005: unit tests run with no bd and no Dolt, using the deterministic fake
bd for backend behavior. Live checks stay on the designated scratch testbed.
replacement: Name the test_runtime_templates.py unit-test invocation in this bound so it is explicit that this suite runs without bd or Dolt and uses the fake bd for backend behavior.
exclude --id NFR-BDC-0005 --item c-4 --reason "c-4 qualifies release artifacts and only carries the unit-test environment as a bound; it does not change or qualify unit tests"
